entities.name: Query protein GlmU-like
observations: 454-aa sequence; predicted mass 48.29 kDa and theoretical pI 6.17.
Sequence matches reviewed Streptococcus agalactiae GlmU proteins at 45.2% identity and 95.4% query coverage; bifunctional GlmU activity is supported by homology, not direct query experimentation.

Homolog annotations indicate acetyltransferase and UTP-dependent uridyltransferase steps of UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis; Mg2+ binding, cytoplasmic localization, and homotrimeric assembly are homolog-inferred.
Pfam scans find N-terminal nucleotide-transferase-family hits and C-terminal hexapeptide-repeat hits, consistent with the two-domain GlmU architecture.

entities.name: GlmU
observations: Bacterial bifunctional enzyme catalyzing formation of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine from glucosamine-1-phosphate in two steps: acetyl transfer from acetyl-CoA, then UMP transfer from UTP.
Reviewed Streptococcus agalactiae GlmU homolog records annotate Mg2+ binding, cytoplasmic localization, and homotrimeric assembly.
